researchMethod: Web image search followed by photographer/source pages and licence verification. All six downloaded files were visually inspected.

photos.title: A train traveling down tracks under a bridge
photos.requiredCredit: Attribution is not required by this licence. Recommended: Photo by Albert Stoynov on Unsplash (link to source page).
photos.alt: A blue SkyTrain rounds a sweeping elevated curve through Vancouver.
photos.suggestedUse: Primary hero. Strong 16:9 composition; train focal point around 65% horizontal and 39% vertical. Preserve the train when cropping; a dark overlay supports white text.

photos.title: A group of people waiting for a train at a train station
photos.location: New Westminster Station, New Westminster, BC, Canada
photos.requiredCredit: Attribution is not required by this licence. Recommended: Photo by Albert Stoynov on Unsplash (link to source page).
photos.alt: Passengers wait as a SkyTrain arrives at New Westminster station.
photos.suggestedUse: Daily commuting or rider advocacy section. High-resolution cinematic 16:9 image. People are incidental commuters; do not identify them as OnTrackYVR members.

photos.title: A city bus driving down a street next to tall buildings
photos.location: Vancouver, BC, Canada (street signs and banners show Kitsilano)
photos.requiredCredit: Attribution is not required by this licence. Recommended: Photo by Albert Stoynov on Unsplash (link to source page).
photos.alt: A TransLink 44 Downtown Express bus travels along a Vancouver street.
photos.suggestedUse: Bus access, service reliability, or community impact section. Bus is central and landscape crop friendly.

photos.title: Burnaby Metrotown skyline
photos.location: Metrotown, Burnaby, BC, viewed from the northeast
photos.date: 2022-05-05 (source metadata; current Commons file revision uploaded 2022-11-09)
photos.requiredCredit: Burnaby Metrotown skyline — Zacharycmango / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Link to source and licence; indicate any crop, resize, or other modifications. Publish adaptations of this photo under the same or compatible licence.
photos.alt: Metrotown towers rise above the trees and neighbourhoods of Burnaby.
photos.suggestedUse: Burnaby community/local context section. Wide skyline with substantial sky space; keep buildings in view.

photos.title: Red and white train rail near city buildings during daytime
photos.requiredCredit: Attribution is not required by this licence. Recommended: Photo by Ryunosuke Kikuno on Unsplash (link to source page).
photos.alt: Elevated SkyTrain tracks curve between Vancouver apartment towers.
photos.suggestedUse: Optional portrait image beside text or tall mobile feature. The best graphic perspective of the set, but its 2:3 portrait ratio is less suitable for a wide hero.

photos.title: SkyTrain Mark III arriving at Stadium Chinatown Station
photos.requiredCredit: SkyTrain Mark III arriving at Stadium Chinatown Station — Wakasui / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Link to source and licence; indicate any crop, resize, or other modifications. Publish adaptations of this photo under the same or compatible licence.
photos.alt: A Mark III SkyTrain pulls into Stadium–Chinatown station beside waiting commuters.
photos.suggestedUse: Optional station close-up. Moodier and visibly noisier than the New Westminster photograph; lower priority. People are incidental commuters, not documented club members.
